title: Act II, Scene II

teacherSummary.text: From the orchard Romeo sees Juliet at her window and calls her the sun. Unaware of him, she wishes he were not a Montague. He speaks; she fears for his life, worries he will think her too forward, and asks him not to swear by the inconstant moon. They exchange vows; Juliet proposes he send word tomorrow of when and where they will marry.
